title: A repro whose own code cannot import or start is its own error
goal: own_failure counts an AttributeError, ImportError or ModuleNotFoundError raised from the repro's -c string, and a repro that imports a test module needing pytest under the system python3, as the repro's own error. Answers BG-iafrnmc3's repro (a name backlog.py never exported) and the BG-gh2ceakk and BG-4zpv4iol repros that imported test modules.
